providers.name: Buckel Family Wine
providers.notes:
Buckel Family Wine is an industrial style winery located in the Gunnison Valley of Colorado.  We source our fruit from vineyards on the Western Slope of Colorado.  We make Old World Styled dry wines.  White, Rosé, Red and Sparkling.

We have Tasting Rooms in:
Gunnison, CO
1018 Highway 135, Unit B
Open Friday and Saturday 2-7pm

providers.name: Cranor Charolais
providers.notes: Raising high quality, local, beef and Charolais cattle. Offering meat for sale including beef boxes and beef shares. Also offering replacement heifers, bulls and much more. We are located in Gunnison, Colorado at 8000 feet above sea level – raising animals that are well equipped to handle altitude, cold brutal winters, and dry summers.

providers.name: Gunnison Jerky Co.
providers.notes:
We are a Colorado Mercantile specializing in our very own all-natural, handcrafted beef jerky. We bring together a wide range of other Colorado products, including honey, jams, olive oils, gourmet teas, baking mixes, charcuterie boards, candles, soaps, tea towels, quilted throws, and more!

Gunnison Jerky Co. also provides tasty, on-the-go snacks for wild at heart adventurers with health-conscious attitudes. Whether you're heading out on your first hike or pitching a tent for the hundredth time, we're here with energy-charged snacks to help you celebrate being outdoors.

providers.name: Vermont Sticky
providers.notes:
I'm a 3rd generation maple syrup producer but moved to Crested Butte, CO in 1999. I return to VT to make maple syrup with my family each year then bring it to CO and sell around the Western Slope. With our organic maple sugar, I make a number of products here in the Gunnison Valley. 
Maple sugar hot cocoa (5 flavors)
maple sugar electrolyte drink mix (2 flavors)

Because I'm making the above products in CO, my business is in CO and I have lived in CO for 25 years, I would love to include the Colorado Proud logo.
